title: Imports and adapter libraries
preamble:
# Imports and adapter libraries

The `import` mechanism: how DS files reference declarations from other DS
files (adapter libraries, rule packs, stdlib), how names
resolve, and what the import-graph contract is. The
compiler-side discovery model — which files the compiler
reads when `import X` appears in source — is named here as
a build-pipeline concern that the spec does not commit to a
specific shape for.

Paired with:

- [LGRA] — `import` and `from` are
  class-1 hard keywords; grammar productions live here.
- [LLEX.10.4] — leading-underscore identifiers.
- [LADP] — adapters
  ship their service declarations as `.ds` library files
  consumed via `import`.
- [LHYD] — hydration services are
  declared in adapter `.ds` files.
- [LCYC] — the
  cycle-detection pass extends to the import graph.

## What this is not

- Not a package-manager spec.
- Not a version / dependency-management spec. Version
  selection is a build-pipeline concern.
- Not the adapter-runtime-registration spec — adapter
  binaries register callbacks against libds's C API
  separately from the source-level import; see
  [LADP].
- Not a stdlib catalogue. The set of bundled `.ds` library
  files the reference compiler ships with is a runtime /
  distribution concern.
